test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement’.

The Privacy Shield establishes a process to allow companies to transfer consumer data from European Union countries to the United States __in compliance in__ EU law.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"in compliance in EU law"** is grammatically incorrect and unclear.
 
• The correct prepositional phrase should be **"in compliance with EU law"** to indicate that the process adheres to or follows the regulations set by EU law.
 
• This ensures that the sentence is grammatically correct and clearly communicated.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The Privacy Shield establishes a process to allow companies to transfer consumer data from European Union countries to the United States in compliance with EU law."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: in compliance under the** – This phrase is grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
• **Option 3: in compliance for the** – This phrase is also not appropriate for this context.
